# Test-only frequency data

`lexicore-5000.txt` is the LexiCore-5000 frequency selection (v1.0.0).

Source and attribution: **LexiCore-5000 (v1.0.0)**, https://github.com/X-Trivle/LexiCore — **CC BY 4.0**. Frequency evidence: see the source repository and its NOTICE.md and data provenance notes.

This file was copied without reordering or editing the 5,000-word source selection. Source license: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Used only by `scripts/build_5000_test_fixture.py` to construct an isolated load-testing dictionary. New words in this fixture have explicitly fake translations and pronunciations and **must never be shipped in an educational APK**. This does not claim that our full 5,000-word learning corpus has been translated or validated.
